exposure: preeclamptic serum (preterm <34 weeks gestation, term >37 weeks gestation)
cohort: The study utilized human omental arteries collected from normotensive pregnant patients at term and serum samples from pregnancies complicated by preterm or term preeclampsia, as well as healthy gestation-matched controls.
finding: All pregnant serum treatments successfully drove vasoconstriction in human omental arteries, and esomeprazole demonstrated the ability to drive vasorelaxation of pre-constricted vessels only when treated with preeclamptic serum.
gest_age: Term (for omental artery donors); preterm (<34 weeks gestation) and term (>37 weeks gestation) for serum donors.
